author: Xleft4dexy

title: Honestly the best habit tracker app
body: In my opinion, it’s the best & most straightforward habit tracker app on the store. I’ve downloaded and tried many which meant not being able to stick to it. But this!! I I kept coming back and stuck to it for good. The free version is already sweet on its own. So if you love it, buy the premium to support the developers 🤍 My feedback would be, I hope there’s some way we could export our data to print them out. It would be a great add-on to physically have my hardwork on paper.
